description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing and querying DeviceProfile entities in a SQL database, using Spring Data JPA. It includes methods for retrieving device profile info, default profiles, profiles by tenant, image links, and batch processing.

classes.name: DeviceProfileRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for DeviceProfileEntity, providing custom query methods for device profile data retrieval.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves DeviceProfileInfo by device profile UUID.

methods.name: findDeviceProfiles
methods.description: Finds paginated device profiles for a tenant with optional text search.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds paginated DeviceProfileInfo objects for a tenant with optional text search.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds paginated DeviceProfileInfo objects filtered by tenant, text search, and transport type.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfosByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds device profile info list by tenant ID and list of profile IDs.

methods.name: findByDefaultTrueAndTenantId
methods.description: Finds the default device profile entity for a tenant.

methods.name: findDefaultDeviceProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves default device profile info for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device profile entity by tenant ID and profile name.

methods.name: findByProvisionDeviceKey
methods.description: Finds a device profile entity by provision device key.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds device profile info list by tenant ID and image link with pagination.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds device profile info list by image link with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a device profile by its UUID.

methods.name: findAllByImageNotNull
methods.description: Finds all device profiles with non-null images, paginated.

methods.name: findActiveTenantDeviceProfileNames
methods.description: Finds active device profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findAllTenantDeviceProfileNames
methods.description: Finds all device profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of device profile fields after a given ID for batch processing.
